action_plan.acceptance: validator coordinate_system and geometry_closure checks pass in strict_real_data mode
action_plan.why: 没有统一坐标系和 B/T/K/P marker，Chrono 中杆件闭合方向、支腿高度和足垫位置都无法证明。

action_plan.acceptance: validator constraint_topology check passes and every slider axis is unit length
action_plan.why: 真实铰链类型、轴向、限位和伸缩副决定机构自由度，不能从 PB/PT/PK 长度反推。

action_plan.acceptance: validator body_mass_inertia check passes for main strut, auxiliary struts and footpad of every leg
action_plan.why: Chrono 刚体杆件会参与冲击和反弹，质量/惯量不能继续使用占位值。

action_plan.acceptance: validator buffer_law and lock_hardware checks pass or lock hardware is explicitly moved to a separate platform-side model
action_plan.why: Thies 给出了可数字化曲线和结果量级，但没有完整 stroke limit、伸出/回弹规则和锁紧硬件。

action_plan.acceptance: validator ready=true, builder writes Input/chrono_real_leg_mechanism_config.json, runtime gate runs strict config
action_plan.why: 只有这个链路通过后，才允许把模型标为真实机构分支，而不是 Stage 3A 代理。
